brief:
Israeli forces shot and killed a Palestinian man in Jabalia refugee camp in northern Gaza, the Wafa news agency reported, citing sources at Gaza City's al-Shifa Hospital.

The circumstances surrounding the shooting were not detailed in the available report. The incident occurred as tensions remain elevated across Gaza and the West Bank.

Israeli forces also arrested four Palestinian farmers in the West Bank during the same period, though further details on the arrests were not immediately available.

title: Israeli forces kill Palestinian in Gaza, arrest farmers in West Bank
